case.summary: This is an online card-not-present purchase, and the identity record marks the device as new for the account. The card has never been used on this device before, every one of the unnamed match flags is true, and the transaction carries no distance value, which together fit the same new-device fraud pattern seen in the prior confirmed cases. The amount is not a tiny probe authorization, so this is not card testing; the evidence points to card-not-present fraud from a new device rather than legitimate activity.
